note: DoD self-assessment per RESEARCH.md §2 (14 items). Each ∈ {0, 0.5, 1}. Scored on OBSERVED evidence only — an item stays at 0.5 until it has been seen working on real repos, not just on the synthetic one.

justification.D1: docker compose up -d --build brings up n8n + sidecar + dashboard in one container (Temurin 8/11/17/21, Maven 3.9.9, Gradle 8.10.2, gh); the ijt_data volume survives restarts; entrypoint automates owner setup, workflow import + activation and the 10-year token mint.
justification.D2: Synth (file:// remote) plus ten GitHub repos targeted purely through env / webhook config — Maven and Gradle, single and multi-module, JUnit 4 and 5, no source edits.
justification.D3: Per-class JaCoCo line coverage, PIT mutation score and MAC, before and after, stored per file and exposed via /api/metrics and the dashboard. Parsers pinned by unit tests against realistic report fragments after two parsing defects (method-counter, self-closing class) produced wrong per-class numbers.
justification.D4: Observed ΔMAC > 0 with the suite green: synth Pricing 0→100, synth Validator 8.51→…, commons-text Counter 0→100 (100 % covered, 0 % mutation — the archetype), json-java XMLParserConfiguration 0→14.65. Multi-round criterion and the diminishing-returns stop both observed firing.
justification.D5: One branch + cumulative PR per improved class, none for unimproved ones; prepared-PR artifacts under /data/prs in local mode. Verified on synth and on json-java / commons-text.
justification.D6: Stage and live progress line update within ~2 s on the dashboard; every stage of the brief (picking a class, improving coverage, improving mutation, improving MAC, preparing PR) observed live during runs.
justification.D7: All six stages applied. Observed: UI classes excluded from picking by rule, branch-per-class naming, PR titled and structured per AGENTS.md, check_changes vetoing a non-improving change ('MAC did not improve (0 → 0)').
justification.D8: 65 nodes, all native (trigger / HTTP Request / Code / IF / NoOp). Generator refuses to emit if a non-native node appears, if a Code node references child_process/fs, or if any Code node fails to parse.
justification.D9: 0.5 — Maven is proven across five repos (single and multi-module, JDK fallback discovering the real build JDK, JaCoCo agent conflict handled, PIT wiring injected for JUnit 5). The GRADLE path has produced no improvement yet: the PIT init script was rejected for an insecure http repository, and after that fix json-path still produced no report. Two Gradle repos remain unproven.
justification.D10: Caddy basic auth in front of improve-java-tests-n8n.mikhailov.tech with its own password; 10-year n8n JWT injected via header_up Cookie so n8n never shows a login screen; dashboard at /dashboard. Verified: 401 without credentials, 200 with, /rest/login returns the owner account.
justification.D11: Model thinking runs in the thinking channel and a cleanup pass strips residual scratch commentary; PR'd tests inspected (ValidatorMacCovTest) contain no chain-of-thought, only assertions.
justification.D12: 0.5 — the verified cleanup pass exists and re-measures before keeping (revert on green-suite failure or a mutation-score drop), and generated tests inspected so far assert real values. But it has not yet been observed pruning a vacuous test on a real repo, so this is credited as partial.
justification.D13: Itemized per-class estimate (analysis / test writing / mutation analysis / verification) with machine time, ETA, FTE and progress on the dashboard. Test-case counting was JS-specific and reported 0 for every Java diff until fixed to count @Test / @ParameterizedTest / @RepeatedTest annotations.
justification.D14: Verified live on JSON-java: 3 LLM calls, 8874 input / 12471 output tokens, attributed to the unit being improved (org/json/Cookie.java::<init>). Usage is read from the endpoint's `usage` field on every completion including retries and repair passes, and shown per unit and per run with tokens-per-improved-unit alongside machine time and human-equivalent hours.
